{"code": "import numpy as np

# Check the number of rows with missing values in flipper_length_mm or body_mass_g
df_missing = df[['flipper_length_mm', 'body_mass_g']].isnull().any(axis=1)
print(f"Number of rows with missing values in either flipper_length_mm or body_mass_g: {df_missing.sum()}")

# Confirm how many complete pairs remain after dropping missing values
complete_pairs = df.dropna(subset=['flipper_length_mm', 'body_mass_g'])
print(f"Number of complete pairs: {len(complete_pairs)}")

# Compute the Pearson correlation
r = complete_pairs['flipper_length_mm'].corr(complete_pairs['body_mass_g'])
print(f"Pearson correlation coefficient: {r}")"}
